title: Risk Management Challenge
summary: Size trades from your stop and follow your own risk rules on 10 simulated or demo trades in a row. The result of the trades does not count; only how you managed the risk.

criteria.label: Size It drill: 8 or more of your last 10 right
Your last 10 rule-checked trades: a stop on each and no rule broken
Write a journal review for 5 rule-checked trades
